cases.observation: Member/shared Dart client is initialized with the configured public key; the maintained Auth session supplies user identity. This is source wiring evidence and does not attest deployment or current authorization.

The maintained reader checks currentUser against requested userId and sends the profile RPC using the client session; optional exact Authorization header is set when a captured token is passed. The SQL/RLS/current session checks remain separate.
_financialRows accepts a name supplied by maintained callers. Literal references are candidates; the generic site remains dynamic until arguments and the full helper call graph are reviewed.

rpcMap delegates to _requireClient().rpc under _withSession and sets Authorization to the captured session token. The generator recognizes rpcMap only under lib/admin; arbitrary functions ending in Rpc are not treated as database calls.

serviceClient takes the service key environment name; userClient uses the anon key and passed Authorization header, and requireUser calls Auth.getUser. Names alone do not prove actual database role, role permissions, or business authority.

The operator endpoint checks the verified user identity and command.permission before dispatching command.rpc through the service client. The finite command registry is maintained separately in _shared/notification_operator.ts; the generic dispatch site remains dynamic.
The enum directly declares enroll, activate and revoke. These are reviewed finite interpolation candidates; no request execution or business approval is inferred.
The enum declares enroll, activate and revoke and produces the identity action RPC name. These are reviewed finite candidates; the generic Admin request path remains explicit.

Native gateway HTTP transport selects the fixed collect-android-gateway or collect-receipt-successor-gateway Edge route, adds key-id and exact-byte signature headers, and follows no redirects. Native code does not select SQL RPC names here; Edge handler maps actions.

The maintained successor action map defines six public RPC names. Handler uses RPC[action] after family/action/signature validation, and index.ts supplies serviceClient. These source facts do not attest a deployed edge configuration.

The maintained handler verifies the signed dedicated-principal envelope and chooses the operations execution or original supervisor observe/reconcile names. Action payload and current database authority cannot be established from ACL alone.

Operator/worker read uses a dynamic RPC URL with validated operational environment, Bearer access token, public apikey and explicit public profile headers. Static assignments list health, one receipt and list receipts; current role/business authority is a server decision.
The helper maps begin/get/sample/complete to four database names and sends an authenticated PostgREST request with public profiles. MCP action strings are not themselves database RPC names.

The Edge adapter first calls the authorization RPC with the caller user client, then the finalization RPC with the service client. Source wiring is explicit; maintained SQL checks determine maker/checker/current-session business authorization.
The new retention SDK callback uses Admin rpcMap with automatic retry disabled. _call in admin_sender_retention_sdk.dart lists read/configure/request lookup names represented in migration 209.

Maintained iOS Runner code supplies secure snapshot and notification Flutter channels. No direct SQL/PostgREST RPC site was found by the lexical scanner in this native set; shared Dart network callers remain the backend entry points.

Platform prerequisite SQL requires trusted definer dispatch, revokes queue/table and column grants from application readers, then grants narrow postgres reader columns. The effective catalog separately records the resulting owners/ACLs; the app configuration does not grant them.

Applied history uses pg_get_functiondef and replace(body,needle,replacement) to amend existing functions. The small generator does not execute or simulate this SQL; patched effective body hashes with no exact CREATE-body source match remain exposed.
